attempted_claim: Let K1 = Q(sqrt(-1031)), p = 3, K1,infinity/K1 the cyclotomic Z3-extension with finite layers K1,n, A_n the 3-Sylow subgroup of the ideal class group of K1,n, X_infinity = projective limit of A_n as a module over Lambda = Z3[[T]], with Iwasawa invariants mu = mu3(K1) and lambda = lambda3(K1). Prove or disprove that mu3(K1) = 0 and lambda3(K1) = 2. A complete answer is a rigorous proof of both equalities or a rigorous disproof of at least one (for example a certified computation of A_0, A_1 and, if needed, A_2 together with an Euler-system upper bound that forces a different stable growth e_n = mu*3^n + lambda*n + nu for |A_n| = 3^{e_n}).
claim_type: exact mu/lambda values with growth formula
decisive_failure: No verified statement of the prime-to-p Iwasawa Riemann-Hurwitz formula was retrieved, so the lambda=1 computation is not citable. Certified A0/A1 data alone (e0=0, e1=1) are compatible with lambda=0, 1, or 2 transients and do not decide the target. Layer K1,2 (degree 18) class-group certification was not attempted and is infeasible in this pass. No literature search was permitted in the recovery pass.
